title: SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance
title_zh: SWAP：测试时可操控的人形机器人全身避障
abstract: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning.   Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/
abstract_zh: 在人本环境中运行的人形机器人必须协调全身以穿越狭窄、杂乱的空间，同时保持平衡。现有方法往往难以从高维感知输入中同时考虑动态稳定性和避障。此外，对于人形机器人，安全行为本质上是多模态的：同一障碍物可能允许多种有效穿越方式，这难以用单一确定性策略表示。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 SWAP（可操控全身避障策略），一个将碰撞感知决策与稳定控制分离的分层框架。高层、感知条件扩散策略生成多模态、碰撞感知的运动提议，而低层全身强化学习控制器跟踪这些提议并保持动态平衡。为高效训练高层策略，我们通过事后标注获得可扩展的监督：在随机命令下展开低层策略，仅在每次执行运动未扫过的空间放置障碍物，从而构造出无碰撞的运动，并重新渲染机器人本应看到的感知。在部署时，使用简单成本信号的蒙特卡洛采样引导扩散模型朝向安全、任务对齐的行为，无需大量奖励调优。在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验表明，该方法对静态和动态障碍物均能可靠避障。测试时操控进一步实现定制化，将目标奖励（如速度、方向或姿态）平均提高 34%，同时保持高避障率。这些结果共同支持了一种具有测试时可操控性的实用人形机器人全身避障方案。项目网站：https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/
tldr_zh: 分层框架实现人形机器人全身避障，测试时可操控。
